info.name: GitLab commits
info.summary: Shows the latest commits of a GitLab project on the dashboard
info.description: Adds a dashboard widget that lists the latest commits of a single GitLab project. The Nextcloud server queries the GitLab REST API v4 directly, so no webhook or intermediate service is required. The connection (GitLab URL, personal access token, project and branch) is configured by an administrator. Results are cached for a configurable amount of time, so the widget does not hit GitLab on every dashboard reload.
